leads.title: Delaware SB 97 - gender identity anti-discrimination law
leads.documents: Documents prohibition of discrimination based on actual or perceived gender identity in employment, housing, public accommodations
leads.detail: Passed Senate 11-7 on June 6, 2013; House 24-17 with amendments; Senate concurred 11-9 June 18; signed by Governor, effective immediately

leads.title: Delaware HB142 - gay and trans panic defense repeal
leads.documents: Documents bill to abolish common-law gay and trans panic defense and ban its usage
leads.detail: Introduced May 2023; passed both houses of Delaware Legislature in June 2023; awaiting Governor sign or veto per article

leads.title: Delaware SB 65 - conversion therapy ban on minors
leads.documents: Documents ban on conversion therapy for minors and its harms including low self-esteem, depression and suicide
leads.detail: Passed Senate 12-3 May 17, 2017; House 24-14 June 7, 2018; signed by Gov. John C. Carney Jr. July 2018, effective immediately

leads.title: Governor Jack Markell Executive Order August 11, 2009
leads.documents: Documents protection of state executive branch employees from discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity
leads.detail: Issued August 11, 2009 by Governor Jack Markell covering executive branch departments and agencies

leads.title: Delaware legal gender change - ID and birth certificate policy
leads.documents: Documents transgender right to change legal gender via provider statement without surgery requirement
leads.detail: Requires only signed statement of licensed medical provider for state ID; as of Feb 11, 2017 requires affidavit of surgical, hormonal, psychological or other treatment for amended birth certificate

leads.title: 2015 Delaware inmate name-change law
leads.documents: Documents easier inmate access to change name on birth certificates to reflect gender identity
leads.detail: Passed Delaware General Assembly 2015; signed by Gov. Jack Markell June 25, 2015, effective immediately; previously allowed only for religious beliefs

leads.title: Delaware gender identity insurance rule March 26, 2016
leads.documents: Documents prohibition of discrimination based on gender identity within insurance contracts including sex reassignment surgery

leads.title: Delaware hate crime law - sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.documents: Documents additional penalties for violent crime motivated by actual or perceived sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Sexual orientation covered since 2001; gender identity covered since 2013

leads.title: January 2025 Executive Order establishing LGBTQ Commission
leads.documents: Documents state rights machinery - LGBTQ Commission within Delaware
leads.detail: Governor signed executive order in January 2025 to establish the LGBTQ Commission within Delaware

leads.title: Delaware's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project
leads.documents: Documents institutional equality profile of LGBTQ legal status in Delaware
leads.detail: Listed under External links as: Delaware's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project
